userStories.title: readWorkerOutcome reads worker-report.json as the sole authoritative outcome source
userStories.description: As the supervisor's deterministic outcome reader, I need readWorkerOutcome to derive the completed story and DONE/BLOCKED/PRD_COMPLETE outcome from worker-report.json (the Event source) and confirm integrity against prd.json passes (the State source), so that handoff.json leaves the outcome path and the CAM_IMPLEMENTER_STATUS sentinel is no longer a control gate.
acceptanceCriteria: readWorkerOutcome resolves WHICH story completed from report.story (the worker-report.json Event source) as the primary signal, no longer from handoff.lastCompletedStory.id: a report naming story B while handoff names story A yields outcome.storyId === B (report wins). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

Integrity is a read-only confirmation (event-vs-state, no double-write): a report with outcome DONE for story S yields kind 'pass' only when prd.json shows that story passes:true; a DONE report whose story is still passes:false yields kind 'incomplete' (supervisor finalize required), never a false 'pass'. readWorkerOutcome does not write prd.json. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

handoff.json is removed from the outcome decision path: a stale or absent handoff.json does not change which story the outcome names or whether it is a pass. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

The CAM_IMPLEMENTER_STATUS sentinel is no longer parsed as a gate: a DONE sentinel that disagrees with the report does not override the report and never produces a fail-on-mismatch by itself. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

BLOCKED and PRD_COMPLETE handling is sourced from the report: report.outcome beginning with BLOCKED yields kind 'blocked' (storyId from report.story), and report.outcome PRD_COMPLETE yields kind 'pass' with storyId undefined. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

The readWorkerOutcome contract (module header and/or function doc) states that worker-report.json is the authoritative source and that handoff.json and the sentinel are no longer outcome gates. userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/result.ts (readWorkerOutcome ~lines 268-424). INVERT the current layering: worker-report.json moves from the FALLBACK branch (lines 336-385, only when neither handoff nor a DONE sentinel yielded a story id) to the PRIMARY read. handoff.json LEAVES the outcome path: readHandoff (line 311) no longer drives story selection (the handoffPath option may remain on ReadWorkerOutcomeOptions for backward-compat but is not consulted to pick the story); drop the DONE-sentinel-vs-handoff mismatch->fail block (lines 318-330) and the handoff-authoritative completedStory resolution (lines 332-334). parseSentinel (line 80) stays only as human-readable corroboration, never a gate. userStories.description: As the supervisor, I need a report that is absent, malformed, or stale (story != dispatched, via expectedStoryId) to fall through to the pane-died and timeout nets with no false pass, and the staleness guard to be part of the PRIMARY outcome path rather than a fallback branch, so a leftover or wrong-story report can never be mistaken for a fresh completion.
acceptanceCriteria: The expectedStoryId staleness guard is applied on the PRIMARY report read (not only the old fallback branch): a report whose story != expectedStoryId is rejected as stale and produces no pass or blocked outcome. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

An absent or malformed (unparseable or wrong-shape, e.g. missing string story/outcome discriminators) report yields a non-committal outcome (kind 'unknown') so the loop's pane-died and timeout nets remain the terminal signal; no false 'pass'. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

A stale report (clearWorkerReport failed, or the worker crashed after writing) does not finalize a story: the integrity check against prd.passes plus the staleness guard together prevent a false pass. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

Loop-level: when the report never appears (or is stale and rejected), completion-detect does not finalize a pass on the report; the pane-died / timeout nets fire with the CAM-44 backoff intact. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]
